title: filesystem: Fix directory locations on MSYS2
description:
Previously, MSYS2 set `running_in_build_directory_flag` whenever
the program was not in the `bin` directory, similar to the various
UN*X installation. This worked, even when installing from the NSIS
package added later, because the Windows installation never set that
flag, due to the directory layout being the same in the run directory
and the package.

After a616eb00d1369cba8d42950ec3620a8490e7fe06 (on earlier branches)
this was no longer true for the extcaps, and then for the plugin
directories 7879bc805ec276033020d28036a922fb2c0bd976 made them
different between the run directory and package install on Windows.

So now for MSYS2 we have three different possible directory layouts -
running from the install directory, which can be detected similarly
to Windows, searching for `libwsutil.lib.a` instead of `wsutil.lib`,
a POSIX style directory layout from the cmake `install` command, or
the Windows style layout used from the NSIS package. Handle all
three of them by rearranging the ifdefs. (This is somewhat similar
to how macOS can be in an Application Bundle, in the standard POSIX
layout, or from the build directory.)

AI-Assisted: no

changes_data.diff:
@@ -174,7 +174,7 @@ if(WIN32)
 endif()
 # macOS and Windows bundle Wireshark and Stratoshark separately, so they don't need
 # a "project specific" subdirectory to hold the differences between them.
-if (WIN32 OR APPLE)
+if ((WIN32 AND NOT DEFINED ENV{MSYSTEM}) OR APPLE)
 	option(ENABLE_SEPARATE_PROJECT_NAME         "Use project name as a subdirectory in the installation" OFF)
 else()
 	option(ENABLE_SEPARATE_PROJECT_NAME         "Use project name as a subdirectory in the installation" ON)
